title: Get_Cultured_ccbfe149
style: Global pop with Afrobeat and Latin influences. A bright, clean electric guitar plays syncopated, palm-muted rhythmic patterns. The percussion features a driving kick drum on every beat, a crisp snare on the backbeat, and a dense layer of shakers and woodblocks. A melodic synth bass follows the kick drum with short, punchy notes. Male lead vocals are clear and forward in the mix, supported by a large group of backing vocalists singing in unison during the chorus. The arrangement includes occasional brass stabs and a high-pitched, percussive synth lead. Tempo is 115 BPM in the key of G Major.
lyrics:
[Intro]
[syncopated palm-muted electric guitar, shaker, woodblock]

[Verse 1]
[male lead vocals]
You want to know how to say hello in Swahili?
[kick drum and synth bass enter]
You want to know what they eat in Napoli?
You want to move like they move in Rio?
You want to feel what they're feeling? So let's go!

[Chorus]
[group vocals, full percussion, brass stabs]
Get culture, get culture, learn before you learn
Get culture, get culture, culture in your hand
Get culture, get culture, every continent's calling
Get culture, get culture, get us all falling

[Verse 2]
[male lead vocals]
Hospitality starts with knowing where your guest is from and growing
Say their greeting in their language, watch the whole room change advantage
Japanese bow, Thai wai, Italian's welcome, Irish hi
Ten cultures, ten hellos, global teaching, watch it grow
Culture isn't learned, it's felt
Culture isn't forced, it's dealt
One lesson, one day, one word, one connection
That's the word

[Chorus]
[group vocals]
Culture every morning
Get culture, get culture, no ignoring
Get culture, get culture, learn this calling
Get culture, get culture, always falling forward

[Outro]
[percussive synth lead, guitar riff]
Get culture
Every day
One word at a time
[final kick drum hit]
